description: Pages when ONE camera has reported no motion beyond its staleness window while the rest of the fleet is active (default 72h; naturally-quiet cameras carry longer per-camera overrides in cam_motion.py). Two triggers: the onset edge, plus an HOURLY RE-ASSERT while the condition persists - added after a routine HA restart silently wiped the notification with the binary still latched 'on' (the edge trigger could never re-fire), leaving two dead cameras under a clean dashboard; the re-assert also refreshes the message when an ADDITIONAL camera crosses its threshold while the binary is already latched (which previously produced no second page at all). Recreating the same notification_id is idempotent - no churn while it persists.

data.title: 📷 No motion events from a camera
